description: This file contains shell functions for testing and verifying the consistency and correctness of Git multi-pack index (midx) files, including checksum calculations, mode testing, and comparison of Git command outputs with different configurations.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Verifies the consistency of midx files within a given directory by listing index files, reading midx, comparing expected and actual index files, and verifying with git.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of a midx file using the test-tool.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Runs git commands under different configuration modes (multiPackIndex enabled/disabled), and compares their outputs for consistency, optionally sorting the results.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs a series of Git commands under different modes to verify their outputs are consistent, indicating correct midx handling.
